summary: Maintains an array of 20 slots (32 bytes each, stride 8 dwords) anchored at this+537 (byte offset 0x864), treating each slot's first dword as an id (-1 = empty) and its dword[3] (offset +0xC) as an expiry float. Phase 1 scans all 20 slots and resets any slot whose expiry float is not the -1.0f sentinel (0xBF800000) and is older than the value dbl_8AFEA8, while recording the first empty slot index and the last non-empty slot index. Phase 2, when a gap exists before the last non-empty slot, shifts each later non-empty slot leftward into the nearest preceding empty slot (StructCopy) and resets the vacated slot (StructInitWithSentinelValues). Called by TextOverlayDisplayTimer (0x004186F0).

operations.description: Reads v1 = dbl_8AFEA8 and initializes v3 (first empty index) and v4 (last non-empty index) to -1.
Phase 1 loop: iterates 20 slots (indices 0..19) of the 32-byte slot array at this+537, stepping v6 by 8 dwords; slot 0 starts at field 0x864.

Per-slot expiry guard: the slot's dword[3] float (offset +0xC, e.g. 0x870 for slot 0) must not equal the -1.0f sentinel value -1082130432 (0xBF800000) and v1 (current time) must be greater than that float value.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(slot) resets an expired slot to its empty/default state.
Slot id test: when the slot's first dword equals -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) it is empty and v3 records the first such index; otherwise the slot is non-empty and v4 records its index.
Phase 2 runs only when there is at least one non-empty slot (v4 != -1) and a gap exists before the last non-empty slot (v3 < v4).
Compaction loop: scans slots from index 1 to 19 through the cursor v2 (starting at this+537, stepping 8 dwords); slot 1's id field (0x884) is read here.
On finding an empty slot (*v2 == -1), a forward inner scan locates the next non-empty slot (j); if the scan reaches index 20 the function returns early.
StructCopy(empty_slot, next_nonempty_slot) copies the filled slot's 32 bytes into the gap.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(next_nonempty_slot) resets the vacated source slot to its empty/default state.
Implicit return: exits when the forward scan in Phase 2 finds no non-empty slot to fill the gap.
